personal.headline: Creative Producer · Campaign Delivery & Production Systems

content.summary: Creative producer with 9 years of experience converting campaign ideas into well-run productions, managing talent and suppliers, and delivering high-quality work across digital, event, and brand channels.

experience.title: Producer
